messages:
jo: FYI after the RBAC cleanup this morning Vault started failing decrypts for our helper service. digging in, I found some secrets under secret/legacy/ that contain plaintext SA JSONs. tagging sec/ops.
vault-bot: [Alert] vault-plain-secret-detected path=secret/legacy/partner-key severity=high ticket=SEC-4001
viv: ouch. can you paste a redacted snippet and list the affected paths? we need scope.
jo: redacted snippet: `{
  "type": "service_account",
  "client_email": "partner-ingest@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com",
  "private_key_id": "..."
}`
jo: affected paths: secret/legacy/partner-key, secret/legacy/dev-batch, secret/old/ci-runner (3 total discovered so far).
arun: quick hypothesis: RBAC cleanup removed infra-decryptor from kms decrypt role, teams fell back to storing plaintext in Vault to keep tests running. we need to both fix RBAC and eliminate plaintext.
sec-oncall: immediate actions: 1) revoke/recreate keys for the exposed SAs 2) rewrap keys with KMS and store ciphertext only in Vault 3) enable Vault audit for those paths 4) scan entire Vault and GCS for SA JSONs 5) notify compliance if any partner keys exposed.
ops-bot: [Task] created OPS-999 vault-scan-and-rotation assigned=infra-team ticket=SEC-4001
arun: I'll re-add the required KMS binding temporarily so services can decrypt: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding wrap-key --location=global --keyring=shared --member=serviceAccount:infra-decryptor@redwood-ops.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`
viv: after binding restored, we should rotate KMS keys if they were broadly accessible. but first we must revoke the exposed SA keys: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=partner-ingest@... --project=redwood-staging --format=json` then `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID ...`
jo: revocation in progress for partner-ingest and dev-batch. doing create+wrap flow now. example flow I'm using:
```
# create SA key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create newkey.json --iam-account=partner-ingest@... --project=redwood-staging
# envelope encrypt with KMS
gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=shared --key=wrap-key --plaintext-file=newkey.json --ciphertext-file=newkey.json.enc --project=redwood-kms
# store ciphertext in Vault (no plaintext)
vault kv put secret/partner/ingest wrapped_ciphertext=@newkey.json.enc
```
viv: important: do NOT store newkey.json in CI or artifact buckets. use in-memory operations wherever possible. update helper libs to decrypt from Vault+KMS in memory.
arun: enabling Vault audit on impacted paths: `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault/legacy_plain_audit.log` and will ship to central logging with 180d retention per sec policy. audit-bot: please confirm.
audit-bot: [Info] audit sink created path=/var/log/vault/legacy_plain_audit.log retention=180d forwarded=central-logs ticket=SEC-4001
jo: adding detection rules: run a Vault-wide grep for "private_key" and a regex to detect SA JSON blobs. example regex: `(\{\s*"type"\s*:\s*"service_account"|"private_key"\s*:)`
viv: also add a Terraform policy (OPA) to prevent Vault write of keys matching that pattern and a pre-commit hook for infra repos checking for keyfile artifacts.
arun: KMS policy hardening: run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy wrap-key --keyring=shared --location=global --project=redwood-kms` and remove any non-ops principals. We'll limit decryptors to infra-decryptor SA and ops group only.
sec-oncall: who will notify compliance and partners if needed? viv, can you take compliance notification and produce timeline?
viv: on it. I'll draft a short timeline and list of revoked keys and affected Vault paths, post to SEC-4001.
jo: post-incident actions (short): - rotate/revoke exposed SA keys - rewrap and move ciphertext-only to secret/*/wrapped_ciphertext - enable Vault auditing on those namespaces - run full Vault+GCS artifact sweep - add OPA policy + pre-commit hooks - RBAC review for KMS keys - tabletop in two weeks.
arun: running a quick scan now: `vault list -format=json secret | xargs -n1 vault kv get -format=json | jq -r '..|.private_key? // empty'` -> returning matches. will iterate and add to SEC-4001.
ops-bot: OPS-999 scheduled immediate, assigned infra-team, eta for sweep completion 1901240000.
audit-bot: please ensure audit logs include both read and write for secret/legacy and secret/partner namespaces.
audit-bot: [Info] audit configured to capture read/write for secret/legacy/* and secret/partner/*
viv: timeline note: detection 1901234567, temporary RBAC restore 1901235600, revocations started 1901236000, wrapped ciphertext stored 1901238200, sweep complete ETA 1901240000. link SEC-4001 for details.
jo: thanks everyone. we'll post full postmortem after sweep. closing temp channel checks. :white_check_mark:
